label: ⏳ Time-series Pro
description: Stationarity tests, ACF/PACF lag analysis, changepoint detection, rolling-window anomaly flagging, and median-based outlier replacement. Pairs with the built-in forecast, rolling, resample, and seasonal_decompose for a complete time-series toolkit. Real-world demos: retail forecast, IoT anomaly, healthcare vitals, hospital readmissions, ER load forecast, financial volatility, housing trend, housing inventory anomaly.
author: DataInsightGrove
